news.text: #Juve Makes A Move For #BaldeAn intriguing ideaThe full-back can leave #Barça. #Raum from #Leipzig is also in the race.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

"#JUVE MAKING A BREAKTHROUGH WITH #CALHA"Interview with MirabelliHakan #Calhanoglu, 32 years old, has a contract with #Inter that expires in June and the renewal is complicated: for #Juve, he could be an opportunity. In 2017, the sporting director brought him to #Milan after a long pursuit: "They called me crazy because at #Leverkusen he was out for months. #Calhanoglu is now the most complete midfielder in Europe and can play until he is 40. To my friend #Carnevali, I say: sign him!"[Front Page TuttoSport]

👀 "#Juventus keeps #ManchesterCity's Algerian left-back, Rayan #AïtNouri, on the agenda ahead of the winter mercato session.During the final days of the summer mercato the player was offered to #Juve while the club was looking to reinforce the left flank (when other names like Nicolás #Tagliafico were also mentioned).However, the deal did not materialize because #ManchesterCity decided to keep him and Juan #Cabal remained in the bianconero squad.#AïtNouri continues to appeal to the Turin management and wants to leave in search of playing time given his limited participation in England.For a move to materialize in January, the terms and structure of his exit will need to be defined with #City

👀 "Due to the poor performance of the squad's forwards, the #Juventus management is seriously considering signing a center-forward in the winter mercato session.​#Juve has set their sights on Gustavo #Varela, the young Portuguese center-forward from #Monza who is shining in his Serie A debut (he is the league's top scorer with 9 goals in 10 games, 11 total goals when including the Coppa Italia).The bianconero club has already inquired about his situation and maintains excellent relations with his representation agency (Leaderbrock), with whom they had closed deals in the past.​#Juventus will face tough competition in the winter mercato, as #Napoli has been intensely following the player's fo
Two foreign clubs (one from Ligue1 and another from Saudi) have asked info for #Juventus’ winger Edon #Zhegrova, who could leave #Juve in January’s transfer window. #transfers[Nico Schira]

👀 David #Raum, #Leipzig full-back born in 1998, could be #Juventus's next free transfer signing. His contract expires in June and, for now, a renewal seems quite complicated.He remains a constantly hot target for the left flank, and many European giants are ready to make a move.#Juve has an open spot at left-back: Zeki #Çelik is a natural right-back, although he knows how to adapt to the other side.THE PRECEDENT▪️ In the last mercato session, #Carnevali, #Massara and #Ottolini sounded out several players with expiring contracts.▫️ Only one arrived: #Çelik, who immediately became an undisputed starter, in a lightning-fast deal by #Massara#MATETA▪️ Jean-Philippe #Mateta, of #CrystalPalace, als

‼️Speaking of strikers, a bit of a trivia... The #Juve management likes (appreciates, no negotiations or offers) Liam #Delap of #NFFC, who scored a brace in the last match against #City.[Mirko Di Natale]

👀 Hakan #Calhanoglu tempts #Juventus: his contract renewal with #Inter is very far from being finalized.A potential breakdown with #Inter would put #Juve in a position to seriously consider him, as a major coup for next season's midfield.The idea is beginning to circulate in the minds of Giovanni #Carnevali and Ricky #Massara, though it is still in an embryonic stage.If #Inter let's him go, #Juve will let Stipic know they are interested, just like #Como.THE CONDITIONS▪️ The player is valued across several sectors at la Continassa.▫️ The precedent: to stay, Dusan #Vlahovic asked for €8M per year plus significant signing bonuses, and they did not accommodate him.▪️ If #Calhanoglu were to prese

🔛🎯 In midfield, an addition is needed who is capable of providing greater security during the delicate moments of a match. #Hojbjerg, who seems to have finished his time at #Marseille, has been on the list for a while: he would be a reinforcement of experience and quality. The other profile that #Carnevali is observing with interest is #Bakola, while the azzurro tinted dream leads to #SportingLisbon: #Doumbia.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇽🇰⁉️ Despite a few positive substitute appearances, #Zhegrova has not convinced #Spalletti. The international break is an important opportunity: with Kosovo he will be a starter to regain match rhythm and confidence. Upon his return, however, competition risks increasing even further with Conceição and #KoloMuani's deployment on the right. For this reason, #Juventus is evaluating a possible January exit in a straight loan or with an option to buy.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

👋💰 #Juventus could intervene in the winter mercato through sales in order to finance new signings:🧱 In defense, #Gatti is among the main candidates to leave and is liked by #AstonVilla, #Bournemouth and #Tottenham. Also on the way out is #Cabal, who has not fully convinced #Spalletti;🎯 In midfield, no particular exits are expected: despite the overcrowding and the manager's request for a holding midfielder, the club might limit themselves to a single addition without altering the sector;⚽️ In attack, #Zhegrova is getting increasingly closer to an exit, without ever having played a match as a starter. #Ekhator could leave on loan to find greater continuity and playing time.[Gazzetta dello Spo

💪🆙 #Yildiz completed a gym session to speed up his recovery. He has circled the match against #Monza in red, without ruling out an early return. Several of the injured players chose to work during the break to accelerate their recovery timelines. #Conceição gave up his four days off: he showed up at la Continassa yesterday to train individually.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]
Lucio Redesigns #JuveThe strategy for JanuaryHunt for a mezzala and a center-forward: #Spalletti is pushing for ready-made players in the style of #Sørloth.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#CALHANOGLU TEMPTS #JUVEThe Turk's contract is expiring, renewal with #Inter is difficult.In addition to the return to his homeland and Saudi offers, the nerazzurro ace is also evaluating #Como: however, #Massara knows him from their time at #Milan... Among the free agents, #Raum from #Leipzig is rising. Nico #González is back against #Venezia.[Front Page TuttoSport]
